name: Da Pupu Bros
notes: No Oʻahu result for this business was found. Search results only returned unrelated vendors (e.g. a Maui 'Pupus On Da Go'), so no handle or page could be tied to it.

name: Dim Sum
notes: The name is too generic to identify. Kaneohe Dim Sum Station (a Windward City Shopping Center restaurant) exists but cannot be confirmed as this vendor. A Kauai truck called Dim 'N' Den Sum was found and excluded because it is not on Oʻahu.

name: Dipped by Dee
notes: Storefront at 99-080 Kauhale St Ste B1, ʻAiea (phone 808-913-8083), per a news article and the Square order page. The Square page lists current pickup hours, and the Aug 2025 article covers a Made in Hawaiʻi Festival booth. The website URL comes from a MapQuest 'sameAs' field and was not opened directly. The older dippedbydee.biz site lists a Sand Island Access Rd address and looks outdated. Instagram and Facebook were not found.

name: Feast
notes: FEAST by Chef Jon Matsubara (lobster roll). The site lists Manoa (2970 E Manoa Rd), Waikiki, and the KCC Farmers Market, with a 2026 copyright. I matched it to the seed by name and East Honolulu area only, so it may not be the intended vendor. Kingz Feast Hawaii is a different business and was excluded. Instagram and Facebook were not found.

name: Fizzy Fuel Hawaii
notes: Only cannabis strain pages and fuel-price pages came back. Nothing about a vendor of this name on Oʻahu.

name: Honest Waffle
notes: A YouTube video (about 18 months old) shows Honest Waffle as a vendor at the Bayview Night Market with matcha and chocolate bubble waffles. No own website or social account was found, and it cannot be tied to Ewa/Kapolei. Current status unknown.

name: Hong Kong Bubble Waffles
notes: No vendor with this exact name was found. Double Three (Kalihi/Kailua) is a different business and was not substituted.

name: Honolulu Burger
notes: Only an aggregator listing for 'Honolulu Burger Co Food Truck' at 220 S King St turned up. It is old and not an official source, and it cannot be tied to this vendor, so nothing was assigned.

name: Island Glazed
notes: Donut shop at Pearl Kai Shopping Center, 98-199 Kamehameha Hwy, ʻAiea (808-777-7505). The Instagram handle @islandglazed comes from a third-party blog (Oct 2024), not from the account itself. A Marketspread vendor listing also exists. A June 2026 KHON2 article lists the shop, which suggests it is still open. The seed area (Ewa/Kapolei) does not match ʻAiea. A possible second location on Aliamanu Dr was not confirmed. No website or Facebook found.

name: Island Manapua
notes: Several similarly named businesses exist, and none is Windward: Island Manapua Factory (811 Gulick Ave, Kalihi), Island Manapua / Aloha Manapua (2752 Woodlawn Dr, Mānoa, alohamanapua.com), and Aloha Island Manapua (Waipahu). None can be tied to the Windward vendor, so nothing was assigned.

name: Jeremiah's Island Fusion
notes: Chamorro-fusion truck owned by Jeremy Quenga. The handle is spelled 'jeramiahs' and is given in Star-Advertiser, KHON2 and HNN coverage. The Star-Advertiser says to order by phone, email or Instagram, so there is no order URL. The truck has been based in Maili/Waianae and attends events in Ewa Beach, Waikele and downtown, so the seed's Town/Honolulu area looks off. The latest evidence is a 2025 Kōʻolina festival program, so current status is unclear. No website or Facebook found.

name: John's World Famous Hawaiian Hot Dogs
notes: The business appears to write its name as 'John's World Famous Hawaii Hot Dogs'. Its Facebook page puts it at Ala Wai Small Boat Harbor, 1651 Ala Moana Blvd, phone 808-780-5995. Hours differ between third-party listings, and I couldn't see a posted schedule on the page, so no schedule URL is given. Current status could not be confirmed. No Instagram or website found.

name: Jolene's by the Bay
notes: Fixed restaurant at Bayview Golf Course, 45-285 Kaneohe Bay Dr, Kaneohe (808-236-1010). The Kaneohe page lists Tue–Sun 11am–8pm and Mon 11am–6pm. The same site lists Ewa Beach and Airport locations, and says Chinatown is closed. Instagram and Facebook were not found in the results.

name: Kababa Mama
notes: Mediterranean smash-pita-burger truck run by Jon & Lana. The site has a 'This week on Oahu' section (Turtle Bay private event, Wai Kai Thursday Night Market in Ewa Beach, Waikele). The site shows a 2026 copyright. The truck roams the island, so the seed's Ewa/Kapolei area is only one of its stops. Facebook not found.

name: Khao and Papas
notes: Not searched. My search limit ran out before this vendor, so no information was gathered.
